name: a code of the checks area holds a blank fix (no_circuit)
find: "give the path of the built circuit, usually dist/board/circuit.json, or build the board first with /spark:build")

name: the fab package's export command is changed to a vague one
find: of the fab package, or export one with `npx --no tsci export board.tsx -f gerbers -o board-gerbers.zip`")
replace: of the fab package, or export it first")

name: the refused rules file's fix is not the design area's (the pair differs)
find: "fix the value the sentence names in the rules file, then run again")

name: a check that found problems is a plain Finding with fix null again
replace: Finding(PROBLEMS, r["check"], check_codes.CHECK_FOUND_PROBLEMS, "%d problem(s)" % len(r["problems"]), None)

name: a run of skipped checks is told as one check that could not look
an unusable project is a plain Finding with fix null again
a missing circuit is told with a fix of its own again
a rules file that names no rule is told with the missing rules file's fix
a class the file rebinds or nests still counts as its own class
find: return {node.name for node in top} - set(bound)
